title: 第2426章 九妙阴阳道莲第2425章 极阴冥骨
lines: 林辰没有急着进入第二重庙宇。
谢诗莹他们还没有完全适应此地，还需要一点时间，虽然在这里他们得不到什么，但在第二重庙宇，他们便可有所收获。
第二重庙宇，至今夏侯家都从中获益，是能够辅助修炼的地方。
谈得上是顶级的洞天福地！
回到池水边上，林辰取出四块极阴冥骨，默默摩挲着。
四块极阴冥骨形状并不相同，有的像是一截肋骨，而有的则像是一节脊椎骨，但大致是人体的骨骼形态。
这很神异！
“为什么是骨头呢，纯粹的极阴之力凝聚而成，却化作人体骨头的形状，实在是有些匪夷所思”，林辰摸了摸下巴，有些搞不懂手中这骨头。
白书也是疑惑，而她所知的知识里，却得不到解释。
这并非她现在还不够博学，而是类似的迷惑，未解之谜，在神界还有许多。
不说那些远的，就说之前遇到骆雨棠的时候所见的万物头骨。
那同样无法解释。
地生万物，而万物归于大地，最终形成了一颗头骨，无论如何也难以用常理来解释。
即便是神界大能，活了千万年的老古董，只怕也回答不上来。
更不要说，这不是特例，而是一直以来都存在的现象，自然而然的发生，没有道理可以解释。
或许只有造物主才能够解释吧。
目前，大概只有神界之主可以给出答案。
不过这些跟现在的林辰关系不大，也只是心中有着疑惑而已，等待了小半刻钟，谢诗莹他们便是走了过来。
他们都是好手，按照路线行走，自然不会出任何问题。
“这池子极阴极寒，你们就算是服用了阴阳破禁丹，也不是没有风险，而且水下有暗流，切记一定要小心，不要被卷进去”，林辰告诫道。
众人点头，也没有人会松懈。
如此，深入极阴寒池中。
“哇，好冰！”纪颜大呼小叫的。
只不过她受到的影响其实并不大，她的体质超越他人太多了，甚至可能不需要阴阳破禁丹，这极阴寒池都无法对她造成太大的伤害。
而其余人，尤其是谢诗莹，需要格外注意。
她是人类，体质是最弱的，无法与天神相比，若非她是林辰的弟子，在走林辰相似的道路，不然身为剑修，她的体质将更弱。
而有这样的先天劣势，谢诗莹就只能用更为精准的力量控制，来抵消环境带来的更大影响。
这要求极高。
但谢诗莹却足以做到。
“这女人，每个细节都值得反复推敲，每一道力量的流转，竟然都是在精准控制之下，以适应这里的环境！”萧雨观察着谢诗莹的一举一动，心中凛然，忍不住有些不爽，但也忍不住佩服！
她有了之前在谢诗莹身上取长补短的经验，如今，干脆刻意跟在谢诗莹身后。
以便更好的观察。
于是便发现了谢诗莹隐藏着寻常行动中的无数细节，这女人，简直将自身控制拉到了极限，每一道力量流动，竟然都在精准的控制之下。
这如何做到的！
content_en:
Lin Chen was not in a hurry to enter the second level temple.
Xie Shiying and the others have not fully adapted to this place, and it will take some time. Although they can't get much here, they can gain something in the second level temple.
The second level temple, the Xiahou family has benefited from it to this day, is a place that can assist cultivation.
It can be said to be a top-notch paradise!
Returning to the edge of the pool, Lin Chen took out four extremely Yin bones and rubbed them silently.
The shapes of the four Jiyin Ming bones are different, some are like a rib, and some are like a vertebra, but they are roughly in the shape of human bones.
This is amazing!
"Why is it a bone? It is a bit unbelievable that it is formed by the condensed power of pure extreme yin and turned into the shape of a human bone." Lin Chen touched his chin, somewhat confused about the bone in his hand.
Bai Shu was also confused, but there was no explanation in the knowledge she knew.
This is not because she is not knowledgeable enough now, but that there are still many similar confusions and unsolved mysteries in the God Realm.
Not to mention those far away, let’s talk about the skulls of all things that I saw when I met Luo Yutang before.
That's also unexplainable.
The earth produces all things, and all things return to the earth, eventually forming a skull. It is difficult to explain it with common sense.
Even a powerful person in the divine world, an old antique who has lived for tens of millions of years, may not be able to answer.
Not to mention, this is not a special case, but a phenomenon that has always existed. It happens naturally and there is no reason to explain it.
Perhaps only the Creator can explain it.
At present, probably only the Lord of the God Realm can give the answer.
However, these have little to do with the current Lin Chen. They are just doubts in his heart. After waiting for less than half an hour, Xie Shiying and the others came over.
They are all good players. If they follow the route, there will be no problems.
"This pool is extremely yin and cold. Even if you take the Yin Yang Breaking Forbidden Pill, it is not without risks. There are also undercurrents under the water. Remember to be careful not to get involved," Lin Chen warned.
Everyone nodded, and no one relaxed.
In this way, go deep into the extremely cold pool.
"Wow, it's so cold!" Ji Yan shouted.
It's just that the impact on her is not that great. Her physique is far superior to others, and she may not even need the Yin-Yang Forbidden Breaking Pill. Even this extreme Yin-cold pool cannot cause much harm to her.
The rest, especially Xie Shiying, need special attention.
As a human being, she has the weakest constitution and cannot be compared with the gods. If she were not Lin Chen's disciple and was following a similar path to Lin Chen, otherwise as a sword cultivator, her constitution would be even weaker.
With such an innate disadvantage, Xie Shiying could only use more precise power control to offset the greater impact of the environment.
This is extremely demanding.
But Xie Shiying is enough to do it.
"This woman, every detail is worthy of repeated scrutiny. Every flow of power is under precise control to adapt to the environment here!" Xiao Yu observed Xie Shiying's every move, feeling awe-inspiring in her heart. She couldn't help but feel a little unhappy, but she couldn't help but admire her!
She had the experience of learning from Xie Shiying's strengths before, and now she simply followed Xie Shiying deliberately.
for better observation.
Then they discovered that Xie Shiying hid countless details in her ordinary actions. This woman simply stretched her control to the limit, and every flow of power was under precise control.
How is this done!
